record_title: Analytic rigidity for Milman's polar-sum equation in the plane
limitations: The theorem is planar and assumes strictly positive curvature; it does not rule out C-infinity positive-curvature counterexamples with infinite-order contact, analytic bodies with degenerate curvature, or higher-dimensional failures. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from unindexed concurrent work because the motivating preprint is very recent.
